correctness.rationale: The exponential-threshold construction reproduces every finite-state SI transition. Uniform empirical-process bounds and an explicit lower bound on the total infection rate prove T=O_P(log n/n). Dissipativity of the two exposure hazards gives delta=o_P(1) at cumulative exposure loglog n; saturation and an integrated susceptible-time bound then yield delta(t_B)->lambda. Independent exponential maxima and their logistic Gumbel difference prove the probability limit. Balanced n>=2 follows from exact state (1,1) symmetry. The standalone exact-rational forward/backward recursion gave 3468 assertions; it is finite diagnostic, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This identifies a natural sharp mixing-critical imbalance scale n/log n in who receives the last infection during all-to-all cross-community stochastic spread. The limiting logistic law quantifies the exact community-level last-event competition, while the finite exact 1/2 identity highlights a structural symmetry that is invisible from a scalar flooding-time growth rate. It is a marked natural invariant requiring hazard coupling, not a parameter renaming or single finite experiment.
